keyFindings: 153 ranking signals extracted from DOJ v. Google antitrust trial documents
61 DOJ signals matched to existing API leak signals (40% overlap)
92 signals unique to DOJ revelations (not in API leak)
58 signals now have triple confirmation (leak + patent + DOJ testimony)
60 leak signals enriched with DOJ evidence boost
Key systems confirmed: Q*/P*/T* framework, NavBoost (13-month click data), Glue (SERP features), QBST (salient terms)
Architecture confirmed: modular pipeline (Mustang retrieval -> NavBoost filtering -> Twiddler reranking -> ML refinement)
Chrome data directly feeds popularity signals via chrome_trans_clicks and uniqueChromeViews
Google uses 18 search quality aspects and IS scores (100-point scale from 16,000 human raters) for evaluation
